WITH line_values AS (
    SELECT
        pc.product_type_description,
        CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS product_quantity,
        ABS(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS cost_difference
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Products AS p
      ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
    JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
      ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
), category_averages AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_description,
        AVG(product_quantity) AS average_quantity,
        AVG(cost_difference) AS average_cost_difference
    FROM line_values
    GROUP BY product_type_description
), category_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_cost_difference) AS mean_cost_difference
    FROM category_averages
), qualifying_categories AS (
    SELECT ca.average_quantity, ca.average_cost_difference, cm.mean_cost_difference
    FROM category_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN category_mean AS cm
    WHERE ca.average_cost_difference > cm.mean_cost_difference
)
SELECT
    AVG(average_quantity) AS average_of_qualifying_categories_average_quantity,
    AVG(average_cost_difference) AS average_of_qualifying_categories_average_cost_difference,
    AVG(average_cost_difference - mean_cost_difference) AS average_excess_cost_difference
FROM qualifying_categories

assumptions.assumption: `product_quantity` is stored as text, so the query casts it to DECIMAL to compute a numeric average; values that are not numeric are treated according to the SQL engine's cast rules.
